preconditions.description: The number of rows in the nonogram field is between 1 and 5, inclusive.
The number of columns in the nonogram field is between 1 and 20, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= m for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list of row segment counts is between 0 and the number of columns, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= bi <= n for bi in b)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list of column segment counts is between 0 and the number of rows, inclusive.
The number of elements in the list of row segment counts is equal to the number of rows.
The number of elements in the list of column segment counts is equal to the number of columns.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in output)
postconditions.description: Each output row has exactly m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(all(cell in {'.', '*'} for cell in row) for row in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is either '.' (white) or '*' (black).

postconditions.expression: all(count_segments(row, '*') == ai for row, ai in zip(output, a))
postconditions.description: Each row in the output satisfies the corresponding row segment count.

postconditions.expression: all(count_segments(column, '*') == bi for column, bi in zip(transpose(output), b))
postconditions.description: Each column in the output satisfies the corresponding column segment count.
